justification: GitHub provides repository access; Zenodo archives releases
GitHub provides version history and releases
GitHub hosts README and wiki documentation; Zenodo stores a description with the deposit
Zenodo mints DOIs for artifacts; ORCID is a persistent identifier for contributors
GitHub defines tagged releases; Zenodo archives each release as a distinct version
Zenodo provides CERN-backed long-term preservation independent of the platform
GitHub history traces outputs to commits; Zenodo version DOIs and ORCID linkage complete the trace
GitHub carries CITATION.cff; Zenodo provides the citable DOI; ORCID appears in the metadata
Zenodo is indexed and DOI-resolvable; GitHub search and ORCID work lists add reach
GitHub can hold dependency files but completeness is not enforced; Zenodo and ORCID do not address it
GitHub and Zenodo can hold a protocol but the instructions still depend on the author
